items.standfirst: Foreign affairs minister says timing of IDF decision not to pursue criminal investigation was ‘especially insulting’. They need to sanction the state of Israel and they need to make sure that we are not involved in a two-way arms trade, which we are at the moment.It’s a significant loss not only to her family, but to the Australian community, because she was the best of us. The people that run into danger, that try to help others. So it is deeply disappointing that this news was obviously released on world humanitarian day, but deeply disappointing no further action taken … I think we’re all really concerned that nothing more is going to be done about this.
